main.description: Get the requester's own list of system accounts: the other accounts of its plural system that it registered, in the order added. Requires auth; any signed-in account, member or not. A list never written is empty with rev 0. Served while getMembership lists the feature account.systemAccounts.

rev.description: Grows with every write to this list, never goes back: an answer with a lower rev than one already seen is older.

errors.name: MethodNotImplemented
errors.description: System accounts are not served by this AppView (HTTP 501).
